name: realistic-long-en
description:
About the team
We maintain an established order-processing application used by several business units. The team values readable code, thoughtful reviews and clear explanations of tradeoffs. The role is part of a planned platform refresh, with existing support responsibilities continuing during delivery. This is a software engineering position; it does not require recruitment, marketing or sales work.

Day-to-day responsibilities
Implement managed RAP business objects with determinations and validations. Explain RAP save sequence phases and identify the point of no return. Diagnose stale updates using ETags and test rollback behavior. Implement global and instance authorization, and verify DCL restrictions on the entity actually exposed by the service. Investigate failed inbound IDocs, then reprocess them without creating duplicate business documents. Write ABAP Unit tests using dependency injection.

Preferred experience
CDS view entities and their differences from classic CDS views are useful but not required.

Scope
We are not hiring for SAPUI5 frontend development, Kubernetes administration, BW modeling or a GUI-to-RAP migration project. Our S/4HANA landscape does not mean every component is being migrated. You will sometimes collaborate with frontend and infrastructure colleagues, but those roles own their respective implementations.

Working style
The successful candidate explains a small example before discussing edge cases, records assumptions, and asks for the target release before promising a feature. Reviews should distinguish a prepared test from a test that was actually run. Most work is planned in short increments with feedback from users. We provide onboarding, documentation and access to a sandbox. Please describe relevant project work without disclosing client names or confidential business information.
review: Specific transactional, security and safe IDoc recovery responsibilities outrank generic introductions. CDS comparison is preferred, not required. A count of eight is a ceiling.
